interactions.note: The epitope of 9D5 Fab on the dopamine transporter with the tricyclic antidepressant nortriptyline bound was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. The Fab was used as a chaperone to aid in crystallization. The dopamine transporter construct DAT(cryst) has deletions of residues 1-20 and 164-206 and point mutations V74A, V275A, V311A, L415A and G538L to enhance thermostability. Although previous studies indicate that NSSs oligomerize, DAT (cryst) is monomeric in detergent micelles and in the crystal lattice, thus suggesting that a membrane bilayer or additional molecules may be required for NSS assembly.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.96 angstroms
